Data extraction: CSV rows are positional Sequence nodes with indexed cells

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "tree_sitter_language_pack"
result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("a,b,c\n1,2,3\n", { 'data_extraction' => true, 'language' => 'csv' })
puts result.data.inspect
puts result.data.kind.inspect
puts result.data.children.inspect
```
